bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖反弹，重回 $855 上方

read.en: SanDisk rose 6.2% on Nov 9 to $886.51, trading between $830.64 and $904.00. It is below the falling 5-day ($938.4), 10-day ($1,095.8), 30-day ($1,370.7) and 100-day ($1,548.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,274.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,270.00), and RSI is 30, near oversold.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月9日上涨 6.2%，收于 $886.51，盘中区间 $830.64–904.00。股价位于下行的 5 日（$938.4）、10 日（$1,095.8）、30 日（$1,370.7）和 100 日均线（$1,548.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,274.2）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,270.00），RSI 为 30，接近超卖。

read.en: The close broke above the $851.6–855 resistance (Apr 9 close and high), now support. Resistance is $904–912 (Nov 9 and Nov 6 highs), then $926–947 (Apr 23–24 lows, 5-day $938.4) and $980–1,014. Support is $851.6–855, then $804–831 (Nov 5, Nov 6 and Nov 9 lows) and $758.2 (Apr 8 low). A close above $912 would target $938–947; below $851.6, $816–831.

s.zh: 4月9日收盘 $851.6 与高点 $855，已收复
